usedFor: Easy Email Verification checks if an address is valid with “Verify Email Address” before it reaches your lists.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Verify Email Address” in Easy Email Verification
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message can give an address to check, and the action reports whether it is valid.

watchOut: Any email you send after “Verify Email Address” still waits in Needs you for your approval.
